verdict.rationale: sevDesk documents an in-product automatic suggestion of the right booking category and automatic recognition of assets from expense receipts. These are data-derived suggestions inside the product, but neither is described as AI-generated, and the dashboard and reports are standard figures rather than generated insights. missing for 10: explicit AI or ML attribution, AI-generated business insights or analysis beyond categorization, depth of documentation on how suggestions work, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Receive a suggestion for the right booking category automatically.
Your assets are automatically recognised from expense receipts and depreciated correctly
